description: Ferry and river crossing lines in a bounding box from OpenStreetMap: name, operator, countries, whether cars are carried, crossing time, the operator site checked by hand and a booking link where confirmed, and whether an open timetable exists. bbox is west,south,east,north in degrees — longitude first (Adriatic ≈ 12,39,20,46). Narrow with query (port or operator) or country_code. Use it for which ferries go to an island or across a sea, strait or river, and to get the id for get_ferry_schedule.

bbox.description: Bounding box west,south,east,north in degrees, longitude first, e.g. 8,38,16,42 (Tyrrhenian Sea: Sardinia, Corsica, Italy).

cars_only.description: Default true: drop crossings OpenStreetMap marks as closed to cars. Unknown access is kept.

country_code.description: Keep only crossings that touch this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), e.g. GR.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

query.description: Keep only crossings whose name, ports or operator contain this text, e.g. Olbia or Moby.

name: find_ferries
title: Ferry Crossings In An Area
